apps.whats_new:
48.19.3  (November 2026)  SECURITY RULES 47 (MEETINGS AND PRAYER GROUPS)
  Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 47, the same as Website Update 74 (meetings
  taken on the phone, prayer groups, urgent prayer requests). Publishing the rules from here no longer takes those away.
  Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.38.9 - DELETE THESE GROUPS; EVERY SETTING GOES TO THE PHONES AT ONCE
  - A kind of meeting added, changed or removed in Setup (and who takes it) goes to the phones at once, like the prayer
    categories and the usual prayer points. Whatever is set here is what the portal shows.
  - Meetings… → Prayer groups → 3 The groups: "Delete these groups…" removes the prayer groups of the meeting shown, with their
    prayer points and items (for a test). The attendance (who was present) stays. Members no longer see the groups, and the
    next meetings do not count them when they mix the people.
